schematics.name: Cold Cellar
schematics.description: Dig deep, line it with stone, keep the door shut: food keeps far longer.

schematics.name: Pickling
schematics.description: Brine, herbs and jars: vegetables that keep for weeks.

schematics.name: Medicinal Broth
schematics.description: An old field-hospital recipe: bone broth and bitter herbs that help wounds close.

schematics.name: Feast Day
schematics.description: A handwritten menu for a feast, spices and all. Marrow's caravan sells copies.

schematics.name: Stim Tea
schematics.description: Steep it strong: a long day's work, and a hard night after.

schematics.name: Field Rations
schematics.description: Pressed, salted bars from an old army manual: light and nearly ageless.
